verified: 1Password's own incident post says an employee's corporate GitHub account was compromised, that the attacker accessed source code and pushed malicious code to backend services to download customer data, and that customer names and email addresses were taken while vault contents were not accessed.
unconfirmed: how many users are affected, whether branch-protection rules were missing or bypassed when code was pushed, and whether the encrypted vault data was never downloaded at all — commenters noted the post does not state that in those words, and no independent audit of the company's account has been published.

verified: 1Password 在其官方博客中确认，攻击者通过一名员工的 GitHub 企业账号进入内部系统，读取源代码并向后台服务推送恶意代码以导出客户数据，被取走的信息包括部分客户的姓名和邮箱；TechCrunch 与 The Verge 均据此报道，调查始于 11 月 19 日。
unconfirmed: 受影响用户的确切数量（The Verge 称尚不清楚）；公司是否设置了禁止直接向主分支推送代码的保护规则，或该规则是否被绕过——1Password 的公告与整改项均未说明；以及“保险库未被访问”这一结论，目前仅来自公司自述，尚无第三方取证或审计结果佐证。

titles.en: 1Password: attacker used an employee's GitHub account to push malicious backend code
titles.zh: 1Password 遭入侵：攻击者借员工 GitHub 账号推送恶意代码
